why_it_matters: A fact-checking report is not a delivery awaiting a business signature.

before: ordinary lifecycle approval could reach a completed task and return a technical conflict
why_it_matters: Repeating observation leaves an audit record but does not move lifecycle state.

after: audited no-change; observer report is not business-decidable
why_it_matters: The observer cannot manufacture a rejection decision either.

before: an old immutable conflict was rendered as a current unresolved red badge
after: historical conflict shown as handled; formal review unchanged
why_it_matters: History is visible without being promoted into a new current decision.
The boundary does not weaken normal DEV, QA, or OPS acceptance.
Observer assistance must not become a runtime business adjudicator.
